title: One of the best experiences
text: A magnificent visit to the Alhambra with one of the expert guides! Ali, quite a wonder. I highly recommend this excursion with him. The Alhambra is very beautiful but you have to meet it by a guide.
author: Sheriftourguide

title: Great Experience
text: Great experience. Very knowledgeable and informative. He was able to get us last minute tickets. We were very grateful since the last tour cancelled our reservation at the last minute.
author: nsiccama2023
